# Clansurf: where people and local tech meet everyday human needs

> Clansurf helps a community run itself as a node. A node is a group of people who help each other and make their own rules. Everyone contributes in their own way, and the rules stop anyone from abusing it. It works with tech people own themselves, for everyday needs: food, clothing, repairs, computing. It rests on one idea: everyone should get the chance to contribute and help others, and to keep the credit for what they do.

Research from HuyoWorld (https://www.huyoworld.com/).

## How it works
- A node is a group of people working together. Each node decides for itself: who joins, who leaves, its own rules and what it offers. Nobody outside can overrule it, Clansurf included.
- Three roles: makers (make or provide what others need), supporters (use what makers offer, share it with others and help keep the node going), maintainers (help people join, keep notes on what works, keep the node to its principles and train the next maintainer).
- Joining a node takes a yes from one maker, one supporter and one maintainer, then a vote of the node’s members.
- Local means owned by the people who use it, not necessarily nearby. A node can be a place node (people near each other, like one street) or a reach node (people far apart, linked by what they own and offer).
- All nodes together keep a small network body that looks after the shared principles and the Clansurf name. It can't overrule a node.
- Local AI on a node's own hardware can keep the record tidy. It never decides; people do.

## Use cases
- One street: a node on radios the neighbours own, working offline. https://www.clansurf.com/use-cases/street/
- The working paper makes the full case for the street use case: https://paper.clansurf.com/

## Vision and status
- Vision: shaping humanity to serve, to be better and to be productive, for good reasons.
- Status: framework in development. No nodes are running yet.
- Starting now: the first 25 nodes, anywhere in the world (beta).

## Join the first 25 nodes
Makers, supporters and maintainers to start the first 25 nodes, anywhere in the world.
- Apply: https://www.clansurf.com/join/
